data.exact_reserve_text: The result for Syndicate 1110 for the year ended 31 December 2019 is a loss of GBP 0.2m (2018: profit of GBP 6.8m) of which a loss of GBP 0.4m is attributable to the 2019 year of account and a profit of GBP 0.2m is attributable to the 2017 & prior years of account.

prior_year_events.event_name: Commutation of treaty business (ProSight group subsidiaries)
prior_year_events.impact_description: PSMAL commuted the treaty business as at 31 March 2017 that originated from New York Marine and General Insurance Company, Southwest Marine and General Insurance Company and Gotham Insurance Company subsidiaries of the ProSight Group; affected prior years' reinsurance arrangements and recoveries.

prior_year_events.event_name: Loss portfolio transfer (LPT) from Syndicate 3334 (Hamilton Underwriting Limited)
prior_year_events.impact_description: LPT for certain lines of discontinued business for underwriting years 2016 to 2018 resulted in an increase to gross written premium and increased gross and net technical provisions.

prior_year_events.event_name: Change in accounting treatment for loss funds (reclassification to IBNR)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Following novation, loss funds were removed from paid claims and included within IBNR, resulting in a restatement of comparative paid claims and an increase in claims outstanding.

named_events.loss_description: The transaction resulted in an increase to Syndicate 1110's gross written premium of GBP 59.7m and an increase to gross and net technical provisions of GBP 60.1m.

named_events.event_name: Commutation of treaty business (NYMAGIC and subsidiaries)
named_events.loss_description: PSMAL commuted the treaty business as at 31 March 2017 that originated from New York Marine and General Insurance Company, Southwest Marine and General Insurance Company and Gotham Insurance Company subsidiaries of the ProSight Group.

named_events.event_name: Reclassification of loss funds to IBNR (accounting change)
named_events.loss_description: Loss funds previously included in paid claims were reclassified into IBNR, increasing claims outstanding and restating comparative paid claims.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2019 gross claims outstanding were GBP 93.512m. During 2019 the Syndicate recorded a small net prioryears release of GBP 0.2m (profit attributable to 2017 & prior years), while overall gross claims outstanding increased to GBP 133.771m at year end primarily driven by a combination of reserve reclassification (loss funds moved into IBNR), active reinsurance transactions (a loss portfolio transfer from Syndicate 3334 adding c.GBP 60.1m of technical provisions) and reassessments of prior accident years. The prior year movement used here is derived from the managing agent's yearofaccount result disclosure and should be treated as a net figure rather than a gross movement disclosed in a dedicated prioryear movement table.
raw_causal_phrases: of which a loss of GBP 0.4m is attributable to the 2019 year of account and a profit of GBP 0.2m is attributable to the 2017 & prior years of account.
The transaction resulted in an increase to Syndicate 1110's gross written premium of GBP 59.7m and an increase to gross and net technical provisions of GBP 60.1m.
Following novation, the decision was taken to remove loss funds from the paid claims and include the funds within IBNR.

Within the calendar year net technical result, a deficit of (GBP 0.5m) on direct business (2018: GBP 1.7m surplus) and (GBP 0.5m) on reinsurance accepted business (2018: GBP 1.8m surplus) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Note 9 (explicit gross amount). No dedicated 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' table with gross prior year movement was present; prior year movement derived from the managing agent's yearofaccount result disclosure (net figure of +GBP 0.2m profit on 2017 & prior => treated as a GBP 0.2m release). Claims development triangle not provided in the statements extracted. Reserve comparatives were restated because loss funds were reclassified to IBNR which materially affects comparatives and distorts paid claims; an LPT entered on 23 Dec 2019 added c.GBP 60.1m to technical provisions which also distorts year movement analysis. Therefore the prioryear development figure should be treated with caution as a net disclosure rather than an audited gross movement.
